    result = result + rib

part = result
part.name = "knurled_ring"
export_step(part, "output.step")

        with BuildLine() as bl:
            Polyline((0, 0), (leg_length_short, 0), (leg_length_short, leg_thickness),
                     (leg_thickness, leg_thickness), (leg_thickness, leg_length_long),
                     (0, leg_length_long), close=True)
        make_face()
    extrude(amount=bracket_depth)

solid_body = p.part

# Hinge hole on horizontal leg
solid_body = solid_body - Pos(hinge_hole_offset, leg_thickness / 2, bracket_depth / 2) * Cylinder(hinge_hole_diameter / 2, bracket_depth)

# Mount holes on vertical leg
for i in range(3):
    y_pos = mount_hole_offset + i * mount_hole_spacing
    solid_body = solid_body - Pos(leg_thickness / 2, y_pos, bracket_depth / 2) * Cylinder(mount_hole_diameter / 2, bracket_depth)

part = solid_body
part.name = "L_Bracket"
export_step(part, "output.step")
